ja: • コスモリバースシステムを受領し、地球へと帰還途上のヤマトの姿を再現。
• コスモリバース搭載時の波動砲封印パーツが付属。
• 差し替えで主翼を再現可能。
• 従来の「1/1000 宇宙戦艦ヤマト2199」に付属しているコスモゼロ、コスモファルコンに加え、100式空間偵察機やコスモシーガルなど、同スケールの艦載機が付属。
• マーキングデカール付属。
成形品×13、ホイルシール×１、水転写デカール×１、組立説明書×１
en: • Receiving the Cosmo Reverse System and recreating the appearance of Yamato on its way back to Earth.
• Includes wave motion gun sealing parts when equipped with Cosmo Reverse.
• The main wing can be reproduced by replacing it.

• In addition to the Cosmo Zero and Cosmo Falcon that come with the conventional "1/1000 Space Battleship Yamato 2199", carrier-based aircraft of the same scale, such as the Type 100 space reconnaissance aircraft and Cosmo Seagull, are also included.
Molded products x 13, foil seal x 1, water transfer decal x 1, assembly manual x 1
